name: Angeme
description: Añgeme is a comic font, inspired by Franco-Belgian comics “bande dessinée” or “BD”. Designed by Nurbek Nas to help Central Asian comic book artists using a modern handwritten typeface that supports Central Asian alphabets (Cyrillic and Latin). Free for personal and commercial use. Enjoy!
